spec.name: cur2_4v4b
spec.notes: Supervision (2026-11-27 22:20): the stages with ball shaping 0.5 improved (2v2b, 3v3b), 4v4 at 0.25 went flat then worse and 5v5 without shaping collapsed (estimated Elo 1782 -> 1470, training points 1.18 -> 0.72, stopped as diverged at u130): 4v4 and 5v5 again with shaping 0.5. Supervision (2026-11-27 19:30): lr 1e-4 and plateau 6 after 600 updates (cur2_2v2 at lr 3e-4 peaked and slid). Phase D, first curriculum (user: train 1v0 -> 5v5 from scratch, 2026-11-27), replacing cur1 (its 1v0 stage never scored: the minimal reward set has no ball shaping, which a fresh net needs). Slots observation (76 numbers, every size, teammates' calls), the net calls (15 outputs, calls unrewarded), from scratch at lr 3e-4. Ball shaping 1.0 at 1v0 / 1v1, 0.5 at 2v2 / 3v3, 0.25 at 4v4, off at 5v5 (the minimal set). Each stage starts from the previous stage's best checkpoint and stops at its budget or after 4 estimated Elos (every 50 updates, 24 matches at the stage's size) without beating the best by 25, after 400 updates. Opponents: the new rule-based archetypes (engine 2) at the stage's size + self-play. Question: does a net trained up the sizes reach the rule players at each size, and what do its calls come to mean?
